rules: Keep chat PG-13 - English only in global chat, no inappropriate roleplaying, no swearing, use common sense and don't disrupt other players.
Do not advertise, spam, use racial slurs, discuss politics/religion.
Do not grief/steal/raid builds within realms without permission from the owner. Builds within wilds are not protected and will be deleted when wilds reset.
Do not use any harmful / objectionable language towards any players or staff.
Do not use any mods/ resource packs or clients which grant an unfair advantage.
Do not cheat or exploit server bugs, instead report them on discord.
Do not scam players on the server under any capacity.
No inappropriate names/skins/text/builds/signs for users/pokemon/items & no nickname impersonations.
Any form of wagers, casino's or luck based games with prizes are not allowed under any capacity.
No entry fee's for unofficial Gyms or Tournaments especially when giving out prizes.
Do not beg players or staff for Items/Pokemon/Tokens/Etc.
Selling/Buying Items/Pokemon/Tokens/Etc with money or gift cards outside the MMO Realms Store is strictly forbidden.
Using 'alts' or alternative accounts for personal advantage is forbidden.
Do not discuss punishments within chat. If you wish to report a player then please make a ticket within the Discord server.
Do not avoid the chat filter in place by swearing or using any words that's currently blocked.
Do not use abbreviations which includes words or swears blocked by the censor. If you can't say it unabbreviated then don't say it at all.
Do not argue with staff in public or private chats, listen to what they say and follow it. If you wish to report a staff member then contact a Head Admin or Manager.
Do not grief/kill legends that spawn on another player. If you can't catch it then leave it alone for the player.
